offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures motion control products, including motors, drives and controls, sold to equipment makers in industrial automation, medical, aerospace and vehicle markets. Products are built in company facilities and sold directly and through distributors.

primary_products.value: electric motors; motor drives; motion controllers; power conversion products; custom motion subsystems

primary_services.value: custom engineering; product repair; application support

customer_segment.value: B2B: original equipment makers in industrial automation, medical, aerospace and vehicle sectors

end_markets.value: industrial automation; medical; aerospace and defense; vehicles; semiconductor equipment

revenue_model.value: product sales: motors, drives and controls sold to equipment makers; service fees: custom engineering and repair services

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: takes in raw materials and parts, sells motion components to equipment makers; OEM / manufacturer: builds motors and drives in its own plants, sold to industrial and vehicle equipment builders

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia, with facilities in the United States, Canada, Europe and China

specialization.value: related lines: brushless motors, drives, controls and motion subsystems sharing engineering and customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: engineering sales teams selling to original equipment makers; distributors / dealers: industrial distributors serving smaller equipment builders

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: product safety and electrical certifications such as UL and CE, plus export controls on defense-related products

notes: Company was formerly Allied Motion Technologies; details reflect my general knowledge and may not be current.
